summary: Learn Python and R for data preparation, analysis and reproducible reporting. Review the 10-day foundation course and plan your training.
lede: Programming for data science uses Python and R to turn structured datasets into repeatable, inspectable analysis. For aspiring data analysts, research staff and reporting professionals, the course covers importing, cleaning and validating data, calculating summaries, creating charts with core libraries, and documenting results in reproducible notebooks. Statistical concepts and predictive modelling receive introductory coverage.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who work directly with datasets and want to add Python and R programming to their analysis workflow. It suits foundation-level learners who can bring a practical reporting or research question to the coding exercises.
prerequisites: No prior Python or R programming is expected. Basic computer use and familiarity with tabular data or spreadsheets will help you follow the exercises. Writing and running code forms part of the course; advanced statistical modelling and production software development are outside its foundation-level scope.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
